_about: The theorem-to-premise binding as a Boolean incidence matrix: one row per theorem row of spec/theorem-premise-binding.md, in the same order, one column per premise. The table stays canonical for its row premises; `inventory.py --check` fails if this file and the table disagree at any rung. The parameter, condition and gap columns are this file's own, transcribed from the table's "Parameter and gap premises" column (struck text omitted). A theorem holds for a deployment iff every premise in its row holds: holds = NOT(B · NOT d) over the Boolean semiring. See derived/topak-rung-DAG-as-matrix-2026.10.03.md. Since ADR-0053 (Batch 36, 2026.10.06) it also carries derived premises, each an OR of AND-routes (`derived`), premise columns of kind `check` valued from a results file, and per theorem the BASE rows it replaces (`replaces`); holds is then evaluated route by route, still monotone.
